MRI Safety Information
MR Conditional (3 Tesla or less): spatial field gradient ≤ 3 T/m (300 gauss/cm); WB-SAR ≤ 0.4 W/kg; No more than 20 minutes of active scan time per session.
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
Testing used a maximum gradient amplitude of 40 mT/m.
